known_breaks.reason: Hash mismatch caused by bash quoting bug in verified_run.sh sub-133 code path. Literal \n (backslash-n) in $CMD was stored as a real newline (0x0a) via Python triple-quoted-string escape processing ('''$CMD'''), while the bash sha256 canonical on line 95 used the raw backslash-n — different bytes, different hash. Bug fixed for new entries going forward (commit c058d12, env-var storage path). Chain reverted to pre-repair state per Joel's decision (Option B, 2026-07-26). Mismatch stands disclosed and explained.
